# RFP COMPASS — BID COMPLIANCE CARD

## 1. Opportunity identity

- “FROM: Maria Robles, Manager of Administration/Public Information, TBRPC” [source: source-packet.md:S001; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 1 memo header]
- “RE: Request for Proposals: Auditing Services for Tampa Bay Regional Planning Council (TBRPC)” [source: source-packet.md:S003; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 1 memo header]
- “The Tampa Bay Regional Planning Council (TBRPC) is seeking proposals from qualified independent auditors to provide auditing services.” [source: source-packet.md:S004; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 1 memo body]
- “The Consultant must have sufficient governmental accounting and auditing experience in performing an audit in accordance with the specifications outlined in this Request for Proposal (RFP).” [source: source-packet.md:S005; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 1 memo body]
- “All responses to questions and clarifications will be posted publicly on www.tbrpc.org/rfp in accordance with the RFP Timeline provided.” [source: source-packet.md:S007; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 1 Contact]
- “The Tampa Bay Regional Planning Council (TBRPC) brings together governments to coordinate planning for the community’s future and provides an opportunity for sharing solutions among the local government jurisdictions in the six-county Tampa Bay region.” [source: source-packet.md:S010; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §1 About the TBRPC]
- “The TBRPC was established as Florida’s first regional planning council in 1962, when representatives from St. Petersburg, Clearwater, and Tampa recognized the need for regional coordination.” [source: source-packet.md:S011; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §1 About the TBRPC]
- “The TBRPC is one of ten regional planning councils in Florida.” [source: source-packet.md:S013; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §1 About the TBRPC]
- “The Tampa Bay Regional Planning Council (TBRPC) is seeking proposals from qualified independent auditors to provide auditing services.” [source: source-packet.md:S020; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §2 Introduction]
- “The auditor must have sufficient governmental accounting and auditing experience in performing an audit in accordance with the specifications outlined in this Request for Proposal (RFP).” [source: source-packet.md:S021; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §2 Introduction]
- “The RFP will be for the fiscal years ending September 30, 2026, 2027, and 2028.” [source: source-packet.md:S022; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §2 Introduction]
- “Auditor must meet the following minimum qualifications to be considered responsive to this RFP:” [source: source-packet.md:S045; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 5 §4 Minimum Qualifications]
- “b. Indicate that the auditor has the availability and time to dedicate the personnel and resources necessary to provide auditing services and an affirmative statement that it is independent of TBRPC as defined by generally accepted auditing standards and the U.S. General Accounting Office’s Government Auditing Standards (2003).” [source: source-packet.md:S056; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 6 §5.I.b]
- “e. Indicate the intention of the auditor to adhere to the provisions described in the RFP.” [source: source-packet.md:S059; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 6 §5.I.e]
- “a. Public Entity Crimes Certification. In accordance with Florida Statutes section 287.133(3) (a), the Consultant will complete and return as part of the RFP the Public Entity Crimes Certification form.” [source: source-packet.md:S079; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 8 §5.III.a]
- “b. Drug-Free Workplace Certification. In accordance with Florida Statutes section 287.087, the Consultant will complete and return as part of the RFP the Drug-Free Workplace Certification form.” [source: source-packet.md:S080; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 8 §5.III.b]
- “The bid should contain all pricing information related to performing the audit engagement as described in this request for proposal.” [source: source-packet.md:S084; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 8 §5.V]
- “a. Rates for Additional Professional Services. If it should become necessary for TBRPC to request the auditor to render any additional services to either supplement the services requested in this RFP or to perform additional work as a result of the specific recommendations included in any report issued on this engagement, then such additional work shall be performed only if set forth in an addendum to the contract between TBRPC and the firm.” [source: source-packet.md:S087; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 8 §5.V.a]
- “Any additional work agreed to between TBRPC and the firm shall be performed at the same rates set forth in the Attachment B Schedule of Fees and Expenses included in the bid.” [source: source-packet.md:S088; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 8 §5.V.a]
- “The consultant’s submission of an RFP application constitutes the consultant’s express consent for TBRPC staff to contact the listed references to inquire regarding the qualifications of the consultant.” [source: source-packet.md:S090; TBRPC Auditing RFP pp. 8-9 §5.VI]
- “I. Questions. All questions concerning the RFP must be submitted to Maria Robles, Manager of Administration in writing via email maria@tbrpc.org by Friday, July 3, 2026, by 5:00 PM.” [source: source-packet.md:S091; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 9 §6.I Questions]
- “All questions will be answered and posted on TBRPC’s website as an addendum to this RFP on Wednesday, July 8, 2026.” [source: source-packet.md:S092; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 9 §6.I Questions]
- “a. Proprietary Information. Proposers should note any exceptions to the RFP specifications or Terms and Conditions (including insurance requirements) on a separate sheet marked by exceptions attached to the price submission.” [source: source-packet.md:S094; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 9 §6.II.a]
- “Exceptions made do not oblige TBRPC to change the specifications.” [source: source-packet.md:S095; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 9 §6.II.a]
- “c. Submittals shall be clearly identified in the email subject line: "Statement of Qualifications for TBRPC Auditing Services”” [source: source-packet.md:S099; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 9 §6.III.c]
- “Submittals received by the deadline will be reviewed by a selection panel comprised of TBRPC staff who have relevant knowledge and experience.” [source: source-packet.md:S100; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 9 §7 Selection Process]
- “I. Letter of Interest. Availability, demonstrated capabilities, and qualifications necessary to provide the auditing services specified in the RFP. Ability to meet standard TBRPC contract and insurance requirements. (20 Points Maximum)” [source: source-packet.md:S102; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 10 §7.I]
- “II. Relevant Experience. Demonstrated ability, based on consultant experience and specific experience of key personnel, to provide the services listed in the RFP. (40 Points Maximum)” [source: source-packet.md:S103; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 10 §7.II]
- “III. Responsiveness to the RFP. Presentation, completeness, and clarity of information provided. (15 Points Maximum)” [source: source-packet.md:S104; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 10 §7.III]
- “Placement on the short-list is not a guarantee of work and does not constitute a commitment by TBRPC to enter into a contract with the consultant.” [source: source-packet.md:S109; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 10 §7 Selection Process]
- “To ensure consistent responses and provide correct information to all interested parties, questions regarding this Request for Proposals should be directed to Maria Robles, Manager of Administration at maria@tbrpc.org no later than Friday, July 3, 2026 @ 5:00 p.m.” [source: source-packet.md:S118; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 11 RFP Questions and Response]
- “The Council will post the responses to the RFP questions to the Council website tbrpc.org/rfp no later than Wednesday July 8, 2026.” [source: source-packet.md:S119; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 11 RFP Questions and Response]
- “II. Nondiscrimination. The TBRPC will not discriminate against any interested consultant on the grounds of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, handicap, disability, marital status, pregnancy, sex, age, or sexual orientation.” [source: source-packet.md:S138; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 12 §10.II]
- “III. TBRPC’s Right to Modify RFP. The TBRPC reserves the right at its sole discretion to modify this RFP (including but not limited to the selection criteria) should the TBRPC deem that it is in its best interests to do so.” [source: source-packet.md:S139; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 12 §10.III]
- “IV. TBRPC’s Right to Cancel RFP. The TBRPC reserves the right at its sole discretion to cancel this RFP in part or in its entirety should the TBRPC deem that it is in the TBRPC’s best interests to do so.” [source: source-packet.md:S142; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 12 §10.IV]
- “V. TBRPC’s Right to Reject All Submittals. The TBRPC reserves the right, in its sole discretion, to reject all submittals should the TBRPC deem that it is in its best interests to do so.” [source: source-packet.md:S143; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 12 §10.V]
- “VI. TBRPC’s Right to Extend RFP Deadlines. The TBRPC reserves the right to extend the deadline for submittals by written addendum should the TBRPC deem that it is in its best interests to do so.” [source: source-packet.md:S144; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 12 §10.VI]
- “VII. TBRPC Right to Negotiate with Consultants. The TBRPC reserves the right to negotiate with the consultants on the list of qualified on-call consultants regarding their exceptions to the standard service provider agreement, if any, or regarding other prices and terms in their submittals and to require the selected consultant to submit such technical, price, or other revisions of their submittals as may result from negotiations.” [source: source-packet.md:S145; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 12 §10.VII]
- “VIII. Standard Service Provider Agreement and Requirements. Consultants acknowledge that placement on the list of qualified on-call consultants does not commit the TBRPC to award a contract.” [source: source-packet.md:S146; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 13 §10.VIII]
- “For any project, the TBRPC reserves the right to award a contract to consultants (1) that are on the list of qualified on-call consultants; (2) that have an existing contract with the TBRPC, or (3) that are selected through a separate competitive process.” [source: source-packet.md:S147; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 13 §10.VIII]
- “Consultants on the list of qualified on-call consultants who are awarded a contract will be expected to sign a service provider agreement with the TBRPC.” [source: source-packet.md:S148; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 13 §10.VIII]
- “If there are any concerns or proposed exceptions requested to the standard service provider agreement, these issues will be discussed at the time the TBRPC awards a contract, if any.” [source: source-packet.md:S149; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 13 §10.VIII]
- “All references should include a contact person who can comment on the company’s ability to perform the services required under this RFP.” [source: source-packet.md:S156; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 14 Attachment A instructions]

## 2. Scope, term, and program context stated

- “RE: Request for Proposals: Auditing Services for Tampa Bay Regional Planning Council (TBRPC)” [source: source-packet.md:S003; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 1 memo header]
- “The Tampa Bay Regional Planning Council (TBRPC) is seeking proposals from qualified independent auditors to provide auditing services.” [source: source-packet.md:S004; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 1 memo body]
- “The Tampa Bay Regional Planning Council (TBRPC) brings together governments to coordinate planning for the community’s future and provides an opportunity for sharing solutions among the local government jurisdictions in the six-county Tampa Bay region.” [source: source-packet.md:S010; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §1 About the TBRPC]
- “The TBRPC was established as Florida’s first regional planning council in 1962, when representatives from St. Petersburg, Clearwater, and Tampa recognized the need for regional coordination.” [source: source-packet.md:S011; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §1 About the TBRPC]
- “They believed growth and community issues extend beyond county and municipal boundaries, a concept that still defines the Council’s purpose today.” [source: source-packet.md:S012; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §1 About the TBRPC]
- “The TBRPC is one of ten regional planning councils in Florida.” [source: source-packet.md:S013; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §1 About the TBRPC]
- “The Council’s fiscal year is October 1st through September 30th.” [source: source-packet.md:S014; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §1 About the TBRPC]
- “The Council currently uses QBO accounting software and will be converting to AccuFund for fiscal year 2027.” [source: source-packet.md:S015; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §1 About the TBRPC]
- “The Council maintains one main operating checking account.” [source: source-packet.md:S016; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §1 About the TBRPC]
- “Total accounts payable and payroll transactions issued throughout the year total approximately 1,000.” [source: source-packet.md:S017; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §1 About the TBRPC]
- “The current operating budget is $3.7 million.” [source: source-packet.md:S018; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §1 About the TBRPC]
- “The Council may require a single audit to be performed depending on the federal funding levels.” [source: source-packet.md:S019; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §1 About the TBRPC]
- “The Tampa Bay Regional Planning Council (TBRPC) is seeking proposals from qualified independent auditors to provide auditing services.” [source: source-packet.md:S020; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §2 Introduction]
- “The RFP will be for the fiscal years ending September 30, 2026, 2027, and 2028.” [source: source-packet.md:S022; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §2 Introduction]
- “The contract for the fiscal years ending in 2027 and 2028 may be terminated by either party in writing no later than September 30, 2027, and September 30, 2028, respectively.” [source: source-packet.md:S023; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §2 Introduction]
- “Audits shall be performed in accordance with the following:” [source: source-packet.md:S025; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §3 Scope of Services]
- “The respondent will be required to complete the following deliverables:” [source: source-packet.md:S032; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 4 §3 Scope of Services]
- “Conduct a financial audit and a compliance audit in accordance with auditing standards detailed in Section II. C. Required Auditing Standards To Be Followed above.” [source: source-packet.md:S033; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 4 §3 deliverables bullet]
- “Complete a report on the fair presentation of the financial statements in conformity with generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP).” [source: source-packet.md:S034; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 4 §3 deliverables bullet]
- “Complete a report on internal control over financial reporting and on compliance and other matters based on an audit of the financial statement performed in accordance with Governmental Auditing Standards and a communication of internal control matters identified in the audit to those charged with governance and management.” [source: source-packet.md:S035; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 4 §3 deliverables bullet]
- “Complete a report on compliance for each major federal program and on internal control over compliance required by the Uniform Guidance and Chapter 10.550, Rules of the Auditor General and the Florida Single Audit Act, Section 215.97, Florida Statutes, as applicable.” [source: source-packet.md:S036; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 4 §3 deliverables bullet]
- “Present the audit to the Council’s Personnel, Executive Budget Committee, and Council Board.” [source: source-packet.md:S037; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 4 §3 deliverables bullet]
- “Prepare the Data Collection Form for Reporting on Audits of States, Local Governments, and Non-Profit Organizations as required by Uniform Guidance.” [source: source-packet.md:S038; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 5 §3 deliverables bullet]
- “Serve as audit and accounting consultant to the Council throughout the agreement period and as such provide necessary information and assistance on an as needed basis.” [source: source-packet.md:S039; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 5 §3 deliverables bullet]
- “Prepare all required tax returns for the Council.” [source: source-packet.md:S040; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 5 §3 deliverables bullet]
- “The Council is required to file one 990 Return of Organization Exempt from Income Tax.” [source: source-packet.md:S041; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 5 §3 deliverables bullet]
- “If the Auditing Firm, due to one or more accounting and/or reporting deficiencies, is required to give advice, testimony, or other such activity not within the scope of rendering, confirming, or justifying a report of audit services rendered, such service will be made without an additional charge to the Council.” [source: source-packet.md:S042; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 5 §3 deliverables bullet]
- “The Auditing Firm will obtain corrective action and submit audit reports to appropriate agencies.” [source: source-packet.md:S043; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 5 §3 deliverables bullet]
- “Any preliminary findings of possible fraud, misapplication or misappropriation of funds shall be immediately reported to the Executive Director of the Council.” [source: source-packet.md:S044; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 5 §3 deliverables bullet]
- “a. Rates for Additional Professional Services. If it should become necessary for TBRPC to request the auditor to render any additional services to either supplement the services requested in this RFP or to perform additional work as a result of the specific recommendations included in any report issued on this engagement, then such additional work shall be performed only if set forth in an addendum to the contract between TBRPC and the firm.” [source: source-packet.md:S087; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 8 §5.V.a]
- “I. Terms of Agreement. It is expected that the contract shall be a three-year fixed-price contract.” [source: source-packet.md:S133; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 12 §10.I]
- “The contract is for audits of fiscal years 2026, 2027, and 2028.” [source: source-packet.md:S134; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 12 §10.I]
- “At the discretion of the Council, this audit contract can be renewed for up to three additional years.” [source: source-packet.md:S135; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 12 §10.I]
- “The audit should be completed in February of the year following the end of the fiscal year.” [source: source-packet.md:S137; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 12 §10.I]

## 3. Eligibility and qualifications stated

- “The Tampa Bay Regional Planning Council (TBRPC) is seeking proposals from qualified independent auditors to provide auditing services.” [source: source-packet.md:S004; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 1 memo body]
- “The Consultant must have sufficient governmental accounting and auditing experience in performing an audit in accordance with the specifications outlined in this Request for Proposal (RFP).” [source: source-packet.md:S005; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 1 memo body]
- “The Tampa Bay Regional Planning Council (TBRPC) is seeking proposals from qualified independent auditors to provide auditing services.” [source: source-packet.md:S020; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §2 Introduction]
- “The auditor must have sufficient governmental accounting and auditing experience in performing an audit in accordance with the specifications outlined in this Request for Proposal (RFP).” [source: source-packet.md:S021; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 3 §2 Introduction]
- “Auditor must meet the following minimum qualifications to be considered responsive to this RFP:” [source: source-packet.md:S045; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 5 §4 Minimum Qualifications]
- “I. The firm must have been established as a legal entity in the State of Florida and have performed continuous CPA services for a minimum of (5) years.” [source: source-packet.md:S046; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 5 §4.I]
- “II. The firm must submit an affirmation that proposer meets Government Auditing Standards independence requirements, as published by the U.S. General Accounting Office.” [source: source-packet.md:S047; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 5 §4.II]
- “III. Government Auditing Standards require the Certified Public Accountant in charge of the audit to have completed, within the preceding 2 years, at least 24 hours of continuing professional education that directly relates to government auditing and will enhance the professional proficiency of the auditor to perform audits or attestation agreements.” [source: source-packet.md:S048; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 5 §4.III]
- “IV. The firm must clearly state the government expertise of its staff at the local office level that will be assigned to this project in its proposal.” [source: source-packet.md:S049; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 6 §4.IV]
- “b. Indicate that the auditor has the availability and time to dedicate the personnel and resources necessary to provide auditing services and an affirmative statement that it is independent of TBRPC as defined by generally accepted auditing standards and the U.S. General Accounting Office’s Government Auditing Standards (2003).” [source: source-packet.md:S056; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 6 §5.I.b]
- “d. Indicate that the auditor has the minimum qualifications listed in Section 4 above.” [source: source-packet.md:S058; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 6 §5.I.d]
- “Note that the person signing the letter of interest must be a legal representative authorized to bind the auditor to an agreement in the event of an award.” [source: source-packet.md:S063; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 6 §5.I.f]
- “III. Required Certifications. The firm must be able to provide the following certifications.” [source: source-packet.md:S078; TBRPC Auditing RFP p. 8 §5.III]
